findings.description: [AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] Dockerfile: both base images are pinned by sha256 digest rather than a moving tag, the builder stage exports the Poetry lockfile to requirements.txt with hashes, and the runtime stage installs with pip install --require-hashes so a requirement lacking a hash or a swapped artifact fails the build outright. This is the recommended pin-plus-hash install path | verdict=pass confidence=high

[AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] pyproject.toml: resolution is lockfile-driven (poetry.lock is copied into the build), pip-audit is declared in the dev group so the resolved set is audited in CI and locally, test/lint tooling is isolated in a dev group so it is excluded from the production export, and explicit advisory-driven version floors are declared for transitive packages (starlette, h11, urllib3, idna, anyio, click, mako, pyasn1, ecdsa, python-dotenv) so a later resolve cannot drop back to a known-vulnerable release | verdict=pass confidence=high
